reader.requirement: For a relative file in random or dynamic access, REWRITE must replace the record whose relative record number is the RELATIVE KEY's content, and when no such record exists (never written, deleted, key 0 or beyond the file) raise the invalid key condition: no update, record area unchanged, I-O status 23, the INVALID KEY phrase or the USE procedure taking control.

edition-consulted.switches: passes DialectLevel to the relative connector, which consults it only for RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError on WRITE, not on REWRITE

reader.edition-search: grep of RelativeConnector.cs for DialectBehaviors|Edition: Rewrite consults no edition; the connector's only edition switch is the WRITE boundary status
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf26_03 covers a random REWRITE of a missing record; dynamic access, a deleted slot, key 0, the USE-declarative path and record-area preservation are not exercised

probes.printed: A1 INVALID 23 [NEW3  0333]; A2 key 3 still absent 23; A3 USE FIRED 23 (no INVALID KEY phrase); A4 key 0 INVALID 23; A5 deleted slot INVALID 23; A6 OK 00 / A7 NEW4  0444 (random); B1/B3 INVALID 23 (dynamic, before and after a READ NEXT); B4 00 / B5 D-NEW5 (dynamic success)
probes.expected: GR13: invalid key, status 23, no update, record area unaffected; an existing record is replaced

probes.printed: OPEN I-O of an absent file 35; the REWRITE then 49 through USE, not INVALID KEY, record area unchanged
probes.expected: the statement after a failed OPEN is not an invalid key condition

probes.printed: RELATIVE KEY 0 and 9 (beyond the last record) both 23
probes.expected: no record specified by the key: invalid key

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.6.4 GR13  the text is in the clause or rule: "the contents of the record area are unaffected"

reader.notes: RelativeConnector.Rewrite takes the pending key for random and dynamic access and returns RecordNotFound (23) before any replacement when the slot is empty; the emitted INVALID KEY / USE dispatch keys off that status.

refuter.evidence: Probe probes-refute-c07/src/rr2.cob at --std 85 (runs/rr2-002, EXIT 0), dynamic access: after READ NEXT of record 1, RELATIVE KEY set to 3 and REWRITE replaces record 3, not the last record read (C1 00; C4 shows 000000003 NEW-THREE, record 1 unchanged until C2); after a random READ of 2, key set to 1 and REWRITE replaces 1 (C2 00); key 999999999 gives invalid key 23 with the record area unchanged (C3 INVALID 23 [HUGE]). KeyedIoEmitter.cs consults DialectLevel only at registration (lines 62, 72), as the reader found. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.6.4 GR13 ... logically replaces the record specified by the content of the relative key data'.
